source_evidence.claim: The CLI stores -i in iterations; the selected kernel strides over row groups through numRows and traverses CSR entries. A warm-up precedes the timed for-loop, which launches once per requested iteration.

compiled_evidence.claim: Compiled main dispatches a warm-up, then calls the selected density launcher inside counted timed control; the counter comparison branches back for another launch until the requested bound.
